================================================================================
IF, ELSIF and ELSE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  IF v_user_id <> 0 THEN
    UPDATE users SET email = v_email WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
  END IF;
  IF number = 0 THEN
    result := 'zero';
  ELSIF number > 0 THEN
    result := 'positive';
  ELSEIF number < 0 THEN
    result := 'negative';
  ELSE
    result := 'NULL';
  END IF;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (if_statement
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_command
        (sql_statement)))
    (if_statement
      (sql_expression)
      (assignment
        (variable
          (identifier))
        (sql_expression))
      (elsif_clause
        (sql_expression)
        (assignment
          (variable
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression)))
      (elsif_clause
        (sql_expression)
        (assignment
          (variable
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression)))
      (else_clause
        (assignment
          (variable
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression))))))

================================================================================
A simple CASE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  CASE x
    WHEN 1, 2 THEN
      msg := 'one or two';
    ELSE
      msg := 'other value than one or two';
  END CASE;
END

          (variable
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression))))))

================================================================================
A searched CASE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  CASE
    WHEN x BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN
      msg := 'value is between zero and ten';
    WHEN x BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN
      msg := 'value is between eleven and twenty';
  END CASE;
END

        (sql_expression)
        (assignment
          (variable
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression))))))

================================================================================
LOOP, EXIT and CONTINUE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  LOOP
    count := count + 1;
    EXIT WHEN count > 100;
    CONTINUE WHEN count < 50;
  END LOOP;
  <<ablock>>
  LOOP
    EXIT ablock;
    CONTINUE;
    EXIT;
  END LOOP ablock;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (loop_statement
      (assignment
        (variable
          (identifier))
        (sql_expression))
      (exit_statement
        (sql_expression))
      (exit_statement
        (sql_expression)))
    (loop_statement
      (label
        (identifier))
      (exit_statement
        (identifier))
      (exit_statement)
      (exit_statement)
      (identifier))))

================================================================================
WHILE
================================================================================

BEGIN
  WHILE amount_owed > 0 AND gift_certificate_balance > 0 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  <<w>> WHILE NOT done LOOP
    EXIT w WHEN done;
  END LOOP w;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (while_statement
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))

        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)

        (identifier)
        (sql_expression))
      (identifier))))

================================================================================
FOR over integers
================================================================================

BEGIN
  FOR i IN 1..10 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR i IN REVERSE 10..1 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR i IN REVERSE 10..1 BY 2 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  <<f>> FOR i IN 1..array_length(a, 1) LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP f;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))
    (for_statement
      (label
        (identifier))
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement)
      (identifier))))

================================================================================
FOR over a query
================================================================================

BEGIN
  FOR mviews IN
     SELECT n.nspname AS mv_schema
       FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
      ORDER BY 1
  LOOP
    RETURN NEXT mviews;
  END LOOP;
  FOR a, b IN SELECT 1, 2 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR recordvar IN bound_cursorvar(1, 2) LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (return_statement
        (sql_expression)))
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))))

================================================================================
FOR over a dynamic query
================================================================================

BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM ' || quote_ident(t) LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'SELECT $1, $2' USING a, b LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
END

  (block
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))

      (null_statement))
    (for_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (sql_expression)
      (null_statement))))

================================================================================
FOREACH
================================================================================

BEGIN
  FOREACH x IN ARRAY $1
  LOOP
    s := s + x;
  END LOOP;
  FOREACH x SLICE 1 IN ARRAY $1 LOOP
    RAISE NOTICE 'row = %', x;
  END LOOP;
END

---

(source_file
  (block
    (foreach_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression)
      (assignment
        (variable
          (identifier))
        (sql_expression)))
    (foreach_statement
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (number)
      (sql_expression)
      (raise_statement
        (string)
        (sql_expression)))))
